Wibbo's bedtime story went all wrong! He read his book upside down, then wore it like a hat.

The right way to end the day: Brush, Book, Bed. Brush your teeth, read a book together, then off to bed.

Silly Wibbo. Smart kids.

What is your favorite bedtime book?
